name: Wine Cup with Children at Play
material: porcelain with underglaze blue and overglaze enamel decoration, docai ("joined colors") ware
summary: This delicate wine cup, only two inches high, exhibits free, spontaneous drawing as well as perfect compositional balance over its small surface area.
